text:
yana: Heads-up: doing a dark-theme pass tonight. Goal is to tighten contrast for code panes and charts without making the UI 'bright'. Figma link: https://figma.redwood/design/dusk-tokens-v1

ellie: thanks. saw earlier proposals, I like the idea of slightly warmer neutrals to reduce perceived glare on OLED. will we keep lowlight separate from dusk?

sam: Dusk can be the gentler palette; lowlight remains our deep opt-in. For this pass focus: code syntax, badges, and microcharts. Avoid changing global surface tokens.

anya: Quick accessibility note: badge text needs >=4.5:1 on hover/focus states. Currently .badge--muted uses #9aa6b2 on #0b1014 which is ~3.4:1. Suggest bump to #b7c4cf. Also, badge + icon spacing feels cramped on small tokens.

marco: For syntax highlighting, propose these assignments:
- comments: #6B767D (bumped for contrast)
- strings: #C7AE6B (warmer)
- keywords: #8AB6FF
- types: #A3D8C4
- numbers: #FFD08A
Also, for charts, use color-blind-safe variants: #E69F00, #56B4E9, #0072B2 and add pattern fills for small charts (dots/diagonals) in compact mobile views.

yana: I patched tokens:
{root vars}
--bg-surface: #0f1416
--bg-elev: #12171a
--fg-primary: #e9f2f8
--muted: #b7c4cf
--code-bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.03)
--code-border: rgba(255,255,255,0.035)
--syntax-comment: #6B767D
--syntax-keyword: #8AB6FF
--syntax-string: #C7AE6B
--chart-1: #E69F00
--chart-2: #56B4E9
--chart-3: #0072B2

yana: Uploaded tokens under "Dusk - Accessible v1". Please review for microcopy and token names w/ design-bot.

design-bot: Tokens uploaded: "Dusk - Accessible v1" by yana at 2026-04-02T02:10Z. Auto-check: contrast issues found on .badge--muted (hover). See report: https://a11y.redwood/report/1772510022

ellie: Opening short PR against staging with token json + updated code block styles (font-weight 500 for code, line-height 1.45).

sam: I'll run the screenshot diff job on canary. Heads-up: our screenshot suite has flaky snapshots for charts because of antialiasing; add pixel-tolerant threshold.

anya: I'll do a quick run with Coblis (color blindness simulator) for the charts and attach images.

yana: tiny UX copy nit: tooltip on theme toggle currently "Dark mode". Suggest "Theme: Dusk (Accessible)" or keep simple "Dusk". Also add a small `i` tooltip explaining differences: "Dusk reduces glare and increases contrast for code panes and charts."

marco: One more: for small inline sparkline charts in tables, let's avoid using alpha-only fills. Use solid 0.9 opacity strokes with dashed fallback for print/export.

ellie: Nice. After PR merges, we'll schedule a 15-min visual QA session tomorrow at 10:00 for 13\" and 16\" screens. Invite: @design @eng @eng-ml.

sam: Sounds good. I'll also check perf impact of extra borders/shadows.

anya: Adding checklist: contrast, colorblind, spacing, microcopy, perf.

yana: Thanks team. Will iterate if CI flags anything. :seedling:
